GitHub report: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1267

Reported against the published CLI. Intake is documented; the reproduction and implementation are still pending. Preserve the shared SDK output contract and thin adapters.
Omit redundant read receipts when canonical output flags do not compact results
Canonical output flags reportedly add a verbose read_output receipt even when every requested field and row fits, unlike equivalent legacy flags.
Return compact output for no-op canonical output controls while preserving explicit audit requests and all actionable omission, fallback, truncation and continuation evidence.

Compare a one-item read with default output and --output-limit 20: reporter measured 183 bytes / 6 lines versus 572 bytes / 25 lines. Compare list 3 with legacy versus canonical flags: 875 bytes / 33 lines versus 1409 bytes / 57 lines.
